portInfo.description: Port of New Orleans operates two named cruise passenger terminals on Port of New Orleans Place: Erato Street and Julia Street, side by side on the Mississippi riverfront. Erato is listed for Carnival Cruise Line and advertises more than 1,000 parking spots within the terminal; Julia is listed for Norwegian Cruise Line and Royal Caribbean International with secured parking adjacent. Both are described as climate-controlled with ADA-compliant passenger gangways. Driving directions warn not to try accessing the terminals from Port of New Orleans Place entrances at Julia St. or Poydras St.; the published approach uses U.S. 90 W / Tchoupitoulas / Henderson onto Port of New Orleans Place. Line assignment is as published by Port NOLA and can change — confirm the terminal printed on cruise documents.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: French Quarter — Port NOLA frames terminals as near the historic French Quarter — ~120 min.
Riverwalk / riverfront — Julia sits between Erato and the Riverwalk Outlet Collection — ~60 min.
Streetcar corridor — riverfront streetcar line noted by Port NOLA; fare/schedule Not verified here.
Garden District / streetcar beyond — longer-call only; transfer minutes not audited.
Mississippi riverfront parks — weather-dependent; flood/heat caution Jun–Aug.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Confirm Erato vs Julia on your cruise documents before rideshare drop-off — Port NOLA assigns Carnival to Erato and NCL/Royal Caribbean to Julia, and the wrong driveway wastes embarkation buffer.
